name: contracts_helper_agent
description: Validates Jira tickets and organizes them into quarterly contract milestone deliverables for technical estimation spreadsheets (RITM). Groups tickets by feature similarity and produces milestone output matching spreadsheet format.
welcomeMessage:
👋 Contracts Helper ready!

I help you validate Jira tickets and organize them into quarterly milestone deliverables for contract estimation spreadsheets.

Provide me with:
 • Jira ticket IDs or an epic key to validate
 • The contract months (e.g., July/August/September)
 • How many milestones per month (default: 3)

I'll validate eligibility, group by feature, and produce spreadsheet-ready output.
